notes: Flow 1.3.3 (build 411). Workout music: pick your music app and headphones and your music starts with your workout, with a glass player you can play, skip and seek. Tasks can now ring as a real alarm, with tones, snooze and a full-screen screen when the phone is locked. Fitness adds warm-ups, supersets, a set timer, PR stars and skip-day undo, plus a steadier rest timer and workout note. Cleaner Settings with a Permissions page, icons on every button, and Flow's own notification icon. Install over your existing Flow to keep your data.
